entries.title: Lamentations 5:1
segments: ¶Remember, O LORD, what has come upon us; Look, and behold our reproach!

entries.title: Lamentations 5:2
segments: Our inheritance has been turned over to aliens, And our houses to foreigners.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:3
segments: We have become orphans and waifs, Our mothers [are] like widows.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:4
segments: We pay for the water we drink, And our wood comes at a price.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:5
segments: [They] pursue at our heels; We labor [and] have no rest.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:6
segments: We have given our hand [to] the Egyptians [And] the Assyrians, to be satisfied with bread.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:7
segments: Our fathers sinned [and are] no more, But we bear their iniquities.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:8
segments: Servants rule over us; [There is] none to deliver [us] from their hand.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:9
segments: We get our bread [at the risk] of our lives, Because of the sword in the wilderness.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:10
segments: Our skin is hot as an oven, Because of the fever of famine.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:11
segments: They ravished the women in Zion, The maidens in the cities of Judah.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:12
segments: Princes were hung up by their hands, And elders were not respected.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:13
segments: Young men ground at the millstones; Boys staggered under [loads of] wood.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:14
segments: The elders have ceased [gathering at] the gate, And the young men from their music.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:15
segments: The joy of our heart has ceased; Our dance has turned into mourning.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:16
segments: The crown has fallen [from] our head. Woe to us, for we have sinned!

entries.title: Lamentations 5:17
segments: ¶Because of this our heart is faint; Because of these [things] our eyes grow dim;

entries.title: Lamentations 5:18
segments: Because of Mount Zion which is desolate, With foxes walking about on it.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:19
segments: You, O LORD, remain forever; Your throne from generation to generation.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:20
segments: Why do You forget us forever, [And] forsake us for so long a time?

entries.title: Lamentations 5:21
segments: Turn us back to You, O LORD, and we will be restored; Renew our days as of old,

entries.title: Lamentations 5:22
segments: Unless You have utterly rejected us, [And] are very angry with us!
